## Frequently Asked Questions

### Which program should I apply to?

It all starts with our Core FI Program. [Apply to the Silicon Valley program here](https://fi.co/join/homefaq), or check [FI.co/enrolling](https://fi.co/enrolling) for other options.

### How much does it cost?

There is a one-time Entrance Fee to start the FI Core Program. This fee is 100% refundable before the 'Revenue & Business Models' session (Nov 05, 2026), so you can make an educated decision on whether or not FI is right for you. According to geolocation we think you are in the Silicon Valley region, which has an Entrance Fee of $799 USD by Jul 26, 2026 ($1199 USD after Jul 26, 2026).

### Is there an equity component?

When incentives are aligned, great things happen. That is why FI developed a groundbreaking 'Equity Collective' where your program Leaders, Mentors, and FI HQ are vested in the success of your business - for the long term.

Learn more about the Equity Collective at [FI.co/equity](https://fi.co/equity).

### Where can I see the agreements?

Our agreements have always been public and freely available at [FI.co/agreements](http://fi.co/agreements).

### Can I talk to someone about the program?

Yes! Please attend an upcoming [Info Session](https://fi.co/infosession) to hear an overview of our programs and chat with our team.
